decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both down -0.4%, no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($489.29) sits just below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy — waiting for a genuine risk-on setup with multi-signal confirmation. All 7 existing positions are held through this low-conviction day.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 down about 0.4% in a broadly directionless session. There was no dominant macro catalyst driving the move — this looks like routine consolidation after recent gains rather than a shift in sentiment. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, mega-cap tech and the broader market largely tracked each other lower.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和回落，納斯達克指數與標普500指數同步下跌約0.4%，走勢缺乏明確方向。市場並無重大宏觀消息主導今日表現，較似是近期升勢後的正常整固，而非市場情緒逆轉。在欠缺明顯risk-on或risk-off訊號下，大型科技股與大盤走勢基本同步偏軟。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely attractive opportunity appears. Today, with cash just under the usual buy threshold and the market showing no strong directional signal, holding that cash rather than forcing a trade is the disciplined choice.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留在場邊、待有真正吸引機會時才動用的現金。今日現金水平剛好低於一般買入門檻，加上市場缺乏明確方向訊號，選擇持有現金而非勉強交易，正是紀律性操作的表現。
